'''January 2001 Whippany tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Fat Moose, Whippany, NJ in January 2001. [[Thomas Hermley-Keen]] won it. It is known from Michael Robinson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1641">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-18-whippany-nj-fat-moosed1641/ whippany-nj-fat-moose], DeckTech (Michael "Bobafett465" Robinson, 18 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-18-whippany-nj-fat-moosed1641/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' January 2001
* '''Site:''' Fat Moose, Whippany, NJ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Thomas Hermley-Keen]]
